rationale: Fresh examination of the complete raw target PDF89/printed76 and parent PDF46-49/printed33-36 supports the genuine claim's carefully limited scheduling-permission theory. The target substitutes November 15, 1906 at the Governor's office for the ordinarily October 1 quarterly session. It grants no permission to commence that substituted session on November 16. Its sole independent operative scope therefore has no fresh exercise after the close of November 15; November 16 is the first civil date without that permission. The finding is not an asserted meeting, adjournment or end of the parent order. This conclusion rests on source examination, not the removal of the disclosed planted dates or the prior rejection.

assertion_tests.identity_and_complete_original: The raw complete page has the quarterly-session paragraph, Roosevelt signature and September 20, 1906 White House date, with no attachment or further target command. The book prints no EO number. Only the authorized IC1911_WPA_LORD_MATCH.csv and IC1911_ORDERS.csv crosswalks were used for number attribution: entry44/EO506, date and subject, WPA M54. Parent entry17/EO317A matches April1,1905 and printed33-36. This confirms compiled-source identity, not an autograph or a source-grade promotion.
assertion_tests.inventory_and_independent_commands: One alternative date and specified location for one quarterly session. The location is part of the same permission, not a continuing independent office command. No new appointment, recurring schedule, reporting duty or independent administrative command appears in EO506. Parent provisions separately address quarterly/special sessions, duration, quorums, Commission work, executive committee and minutes, departments, appointments, contracts, reorganization meeting, accounts, engineering advice, reports, preservation of consistent previous orders and named appointments. None is silently treated as extinguished EO506 inventory.
assertion_tests.commencement: September20,1906 is issuance; there is no delayed-effective clause. Permission is established then for the later named day. Issuance does not establish its performance or exhaustion.
assertion_tests.first_cessation: The permitted November15 civil day is included in full. Close of November15 is equivalent to the exclusive November16 00:00 boundary used by both first_end and whole_order_end. Excluding November15 itself would negate the expressly authorized day. No grace day or invented implementation interval is supplied. The order specifies no clock or time zone; the midnight expression is civil-date boundary notation, not proof of a historical timestamp.
assertion_tests.continuation_and_savings: Parent printed33 expressly allows each session to continue as long as public business requires. A session lawfully begun on the substituted day could therefore continue under the parent without renewing EO506's date-specific commencement permission. Neither the target nor parent proves that it began, continued or adjourned. Historical validity of the substitution and acts lawfully taken is distinguished from surviving fresh operative authority. There is no express target savings clause or independent enduring target duty. Parent printed36 preserves earlier consistent orders; it does not convert this later one-session substitution into a perpetual schedule.
assertion_tests.earlier_end_and_search: October1 is the displaced ordinary date, not a cessation of the substitution. September20 is not exhaustion. No earlier extinguishing act appears in the supplied complete target or parent. The claim's local session-search.json receipt was not provided as a pinned input and was not accessed: its reported negative result is not independently reproduced or credited as exhaustive evidence. USC search is bounded to its reported release/current-through date2026-10-09, eCFR/CFR to stated scopes and number/form searches, and OFR catalog starts1937; those searches cannot exclude every pre1937, unnumbered, uncited or implicit change. Approval is a bounded source judgment on the supplied permission and its own temporal limit, not an independently exhaustive historical search certification.
assertion_tests.later_events_and_cutoff: No later event is needed to account for expiry of fresh date-specific permission by its own terms. Empty later_events is not an assertion that nothing later affected the Commission or parent. The terminated state at2026-10-14 is supported for this sole fresh scheduling scope; no present predicate, actual meeting history or end of every consequence is asserted.
assertion_tests.metadata: Producer approval, original_pages_confirmed and inventory override metadata do not establish this review. The selected operative text excludes provenance and signature, agrees with the visible paragraph, and was mechanically checked at frozen offsets1081-1407. The claim's empty unresolved_material_gaps cannot be read as eliminating the separately retained mechanical custody and bounded-search qualifications.
